Container.Name: rex
Container.Overview: Personal Rex server with Codex CLI, zsh, sudo, and persistent Homebrew. Load the local image, prepare appdata and authorized keys, and install the Codex seccomp profile before applying. For LAN access, replace 127.0.0.1 in Extra Parameters with the Unraid LAN IPv4 address.
Container.ExtraParams: --publish 127.0.0.1:2222:22/tcp --stop-timeout 25 --security-opt seccomp=/mnt/user/appdata/rex/codex-seccomp.json --cap-drop ALL --cap-add CHOWN --cap-add DAC_OVERRIDE --cap-add FOWNER --cap-add KILL --cap-add NET_BIND_SERVICE --cap-add SETGID --cap-add SETUID --cap-add SYS_CHROOT --cap-add AUDIT_WRITE

Config.Name: Rex home
Config.Description: Persistent Rex state, zsh configuration, and Codex login. Prepare this directory for UID 1000 and GID 100.

Config.Name: Homebrew
Config.Description: Persistent Homebrew installation and packages. Prepare this directory for UID 1000 and GID 100.

Config.Name: SSH host identity
Config.Description: Root-owned directory for the SSH host key and Rex machine ID.

Config.Name: SSH authorized keys
Config.Description: Root-owned directory containing authorized_keys with one client public key per line.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Optional Unraid share or subfolder. Choose read/write if Rex and Codex should edit files there.
